data.desc: Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR) is a fintech company that provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions to financial institutions. The Company's AI solutions, including Seamless AI Call Centre and other AI-powered agents, are designed to reduce costs, increase efficiency and improve customer satisfaction for banks, insurance companies, telecommunications companies, government agencies and other financial institutions. Through Tranglo, the Company's digital remittance platform also enables e-wallets, remittance companies, and corporations to provide real-time, 24/7 global payment services. In April 2026, Currenc tokenized its ordinary shares on the Ethereum and Solana blockchains.
